sanskrit: vāgīśvarī tathāsaṃkhyā tathā ca sukulākulā tripuraikajaṭā durgā yā cānyā kulasundarī śaivaṃ śāṃkarajātaṃ ca yatkiṃcid bhūtasaṃbhavam jālaśambaram bahurūpāṣṭakaṃ jñānaṃ yāmalāṣṭakameva ca mahādevaṃ vātulaṃ vātulottaram] kalāvādaṃ kalāsāraṃ tathānyat kubjikāmatam pañcāmṛtaṃ rūpabhedaṃ bhūtaḍāmarameva ca sarvajñānātmakaṃ devi ! mahāpitṛmataṃ tathā kurūpikāmataṃ devi ! rūpikāmatameva ca pūrvapaścimadakṣaṃ ca uttaraṃ ca niruttaram aruṇeśaṃ mohaneśaṃ viśuddheśvarameva ca śrutvā devi ! na kutrāpi jātānandāsi bhairavi tatkathaṃ vada suśroṇi ! mayi tvatpādavartini manmāyāmudritāśeṣatantrajñānakulārṇava kva brahmā kva hariḥ śaṃbhuḥ kva devaḥ kva manorjapaḥ kva rāgaḥ kva sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ kva muktiḥ kva ca sādhutā māyayācchādya cātmānaṃ tridhā bhūtvā madonmukhī pañcabhūtāni liṅgāni caikottaraśatāni ca sarve'pyāvirbhavantyatra tato bhāvādikalpanā sarve brahmādayo yūyaṃ madaṃśā bhāvasaṃbhavāḥ pañcatvaṃ prāpayiṣyāmi nirvāṇapadalālitāḥ ahaṃkāraḥ pañcamātrāḥ sattvaṃ cātha rajastamaḥ yadi māṃ viddhi sarvajña! kva cāmnāyaḥ kva yājanam nārīrūpaṃ samāsthāya sṛṣṭisāraṃ madātmakam

etāvatāpi deveśa ! mama tattvaṃ na jāyate yoganirmuktakānuṣṭha upāyaḥ kathyate mayā sarvasārvajñyadaṃ guhyaṃ tattvabodhaprabodhakam sarvāścaryamayaṃ vatsa ! viduṣāmapi mohanam sadācāryaparijñātaṃ [jñānam] sacchiṣyaparamāspadam na mayā viṣṇave proktaṃ na dhātre gaṇapāya na etattantraṃ vinā vatsa ! nādhikāro'sti [kāraḥ surairapi] yadyapi sādhakaḥ prātarutthāya kulavṛkṣaṃ praṇamya ca prahlādānandanāthākhyaṃ sanakānandameva ca krodhānandasukhānandau jñānānandamataḥparam mahārasarasollāsahṛdayānandalocanāḥ kulaśiṣyoparikṛpāpūrṇāntaḥkaraṇodyatāḥ evaṃ kulaguruṃ natvā visṛjya kulamātṛkām śāktaṃ kulaguruṃ vatsa ! kathitaṃ ca sukhāvaham kulanāthaṃ parityajya ye śāktāḥ kulasevinaḥ [parasevinaḥ] tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kulīnaṃ gurumāśrayet dīkṣāprabhuḥ sa evātra sarvamantrasya nāparaḥ kṛṣṇaraktaharinnīlā vividhā mama mūrtayaḥ divaṃ sarvamathorvīṃ ca pātālaṃ bhūtasaṃbhavam kulapātre sadūrvaṃ ca satilaṃ sajalaṃ tathā kṛtasaṃkalpa evādau kulacakraṃ jale nyaset kulatīrthāni tatraiva samāvāhya kulātmakam kulamūlāya devāya tridhārghyaṃ parikalpya ca kulātmakān punardhyātvā kuladevāṃstu toṣayet bhairavāya ca devāya bhairaveṇa ca kartṛṇā

dātṛdānagṛhītaṃ ca tato liṅgānurūpataḥ śrāddhe vivāhe dāne ca snāne cāṅgaprapūjane tatastṛptā tadāśeṣalokān prīṇāmi tattvataḥ tilakaṃ kularūpaṃ ca kṛtvācamya samāpya ca dvāradeśe tato gītanṛttavādyāditoṣitaḥ kulāsanaṃ tataḥ kṣiptvā tadabhyarcya yathāsukham dehaśuddhyādibhedataḥ] dīkṣitābhiḥ suśīlābhiryuvatībhiḥ kulātmabhiḥ nānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi gandhāni vividhāni ca tāmbūlaṃ deyadravyaṃ ca dhūpadīpādikaṃ ca yat mūlavidyājaptatoyaiḥ prokṣitaṃ sthāpayettataḥ paścime devatāyāṃ ca kuladravyāṇi dhārayet rocanālākṣayāraktaiḥ [lākṣayā laktaiḥ] kuṅkumāruṇacandanaiḥ yathāśakti manuṃ japtvā stutvā devīṃ visarjayet kulāmṛtarasaṃ pūrvaṃ [pūrṇaṃ] gurave vinivedayet brahmarandhre guptasthāne yantralepaṃ tu dhārayet kulīnāya ca dātavyamathavā jalamadhyataḥ harināmnā jātabhāvo bhaṅgyanvitaviceṣṭitaḥ yāmamātre gate rātrau kulagehaṃ tataḥ pumān kulayantraṃ sādhyanāmnā saṃkulaṃ kulacakrake svaśaktyā paraśaktiṃ ca samānayati sādhakaḥ nijakāntāṃ samānīya suśīlāṃ suyaśasvinīm parānandarasāghūrṇalocanāṃ kulajāṃ satīm nijaputrīvadācāryastadbhālapaṭṭake likhet tanmadhye deyamantreṇa darbhitaṃ nāmalāñchitam

tatastatputrikākarṇe ṛṣicchandasamanvitam adya prabhṛti putri ! tvaṃ kulapūjārcane ratā yathopadiṣṭavidhinā [athopa] sa me vasyaṃ (śyaṃ) samānaya trāhi nātha ! kulācāra padminīkulanāyaka gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā tāmbūlāruṇalocanā sāṅgāvaraṇapūjādau [aṅgāvaraṇa] yadi na kṣamate kulam tarpayitvā tato [kulaṃ dhyātvā] devaṃ japenmantraṃ nirākulam vāmabhāge samāsannaṃ raktavastravibhūṣitam gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpaveṣṭitaṃ sumanoharam jitāmṛtakucadvandaṃ [jitāmita] viśālakarikumbhakam tatskandhe bāhumādāya bhaṅgyā dhṛtakucāvalam kūlākulajapaṃ kṛtvā [kuryāt] samānayati tatkṣaṇāt śatayojanadūrasthāṃ nadīparvatamadhyagām payodharabharakṣubdhamadhyamāṃ lolalocanām sādhakākāṅkṣihṛdayāṃ vivarāntaḥprasarpiṇīm sādhakāntaḥsamāsīnāṃ devatāmiva cāriṇīm evamākṛṣṭi siddhiścet sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavet vāmakarṇe parāṃ dadyānmantreṇaivābhiṣecayet vāntānte tripurāyai(tu) hṛdayaṃ parikīrtitam tato gurupadaṃ dadyāt mama śaktipadaṃ tataḥ anena manunā deva ! śaktiśuddhiṃ samācaret brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca kulabhūṣaṇā viśeṣavaidagdhyayutā sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥ pretabhūmau bilvamūle haṭṭe vā rājaveśmani tatra saṃpūjya vidhivat kulaṃ kularasena ca [tu]

tato lakṣapradānena siddhidāstā bhavanti hi dīkṣitāṃ vastrapuṣpādyairbhojyaiḥ pāyasasaṃbhavaiḥ nānāvidhaṃ piṣṭakaṃ ca nānārasasamanvitam upalākhaṇḍacūrṇaṃ ca nānāvidharasāyanam niṣpāvaṃ bījapūraṃ ca dāḍimīphalameva [phalamuttamam] ca candanaṃ mṛganābhiṃ ca śrīkhaṇḍaṃ navapallavam [surapādapam] nānāśailasamudbhūtaṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitam [saṃmitam] amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śaktīrabhimukhaṃ nayet brahmāṇyādyaṣṭaśaktīnāṃ nāmabhiḥ kṛtasaṃjñakāḥ tathā [tataḥ] dhūpayitvā tataḥ keśān kauśeyaṃ ca nivedayet datvā tatra samānīya nānālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ tāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ samāvāhya mūrdhni tāsāṃ samānayet carvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ nivedayet tāsāṃ ca savyakarṇeṣu tataḥ stotraṃ samācaret kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mama siddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mama siddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * * kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * * kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * * kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * * kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * * kṛpayā * * * * * * * * * * * * * eke bahuvidhe ! devi ! viśvarūpe ! namo'stu te vidagdhāṃ vā samālokya tasya vighnaṃ na jāyate

dīkṣākāle nityapūjāsamaye nārcayedyadi yadi vrīḍāparāstāstu bhojayettad gṛhādbahiḥ ācamya mukhavāsāditāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet namaskṛtya [visṛjya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya] visṛjyaiva varaṃ prāpya sukhī bhavet agrajā vā mātulānī mātā vā tatsapatnikā pūjyā kulavaraiḥ sarvairnijāhaṃkāravarjitaiḥ saṃskṛtāsaṃskṛtā vāpi jananī vāpi niṣpatiḥ ekaścetkulaśāstrajñaḥ pūjārhastatra bhairava ! ekā cedyuvatistatra pūjitā cāvalokitā ādāvante ca madhye ca lakṣapūrtau viśeṣataḥ pūrvārjitaphalaṃ nāsti kā kathā parajanmani mamāpi krodhasaṃtāpaśamanaṃ vighnanāśanam prātarutthāya pūjāyāṃ snānakāle'thavā punaḥ namasyāḥ sarvajātīnāṃ kulīnānāṃ kulārcane tadā tatra pīṭhapūjā manasāpi na hīyate yoganidrāṃ kāmarūpe mahiṣāsuramardinīm jālaṃdhare ca pūrṇeśīṃ pūrṇaśaile ca caṇḍikām athavā kāmarūpasya darśanaṃ yadi bhāgyataḥ kulanāthaṃ tato dhyātvā svayamavyagramānasaḥ pūjākāle hīnajātā svayoṣidvā prayatnataḥ yathā viṣṇuḥ paraṃ goptā yathā ca śaṃbhurīśvaraḥ indrādyā lokapālāśca sarve gandharvakiṃnarāḥ tairyathā gopitaṃ guhyaṃ tvaduktaṃ śāstrasaṃbhavam tathā tvayaiva goptavyaḥ kulācāraḥ sudurlabhaḥ yena hīnā na siddhyanti janmakoṭiśatairapi [kulāḥ koṭisahasraśaḥ]

udāracittaḥ sarvatra vaiṣṇavācāratatparaḥ [parvate vipine]devatāyatane caiva nirjane śūnyamaṇḍape kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japtvā natvā gacchedyathāsukham kṣemaṃkarīṃ tathā vīkṣya jambukīṃ yamadūtikām pūrṇodari ! mahācaṇḍe ! muktakeśi ! balipriye śmaśānaṃ ca śavaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇamanuvrajan ghoradaṃṣṭre ! kaṭhorākṣi ! kiṭiśabdapraṇādini ! bandhūkapuṣpasaṃkāśe ! tripure ! bhayanāśini ! rājaputrakam mahiṣaṃ kuladevaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā mahiṣamardinīm madyabhāṇḍaṃ samālokya matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ varastriyam ghoravighnavināśāya kulācārasamṛddhaye raktadhārāsamākīrṇavadane ! tvāṃ namāmyaham śaktimantraṃ puraskṛtya tasya siddhirna jāyate kriyate yadi pāpātmā madbhaktaḥ sa kathaṃ bhavet ḍākinyaśca tathā sarvā madaṃśāḥ śṛṇu bhairava ! vaṭukānāṃ bhairavāṇāṃ tasya siddhirna jāyate yaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuvatirnārī pūrvadoṣavivarjitā dṛṣṭvā madhukaraśreṇī yathā madhumadākulā cakorī meghamāsādya sotsukā cātakapriyā navena tṛṇajātena yathā vā hariṇāṅganā mṛṇāladarśanā haṃsī madhulobhātpipīlikā utkṣipya bhujamūlaṃ [mūlasya] ca vasanaṃ kṣipyate punaḥ kaṇḍūtibhāvavyājena śithilīkṛtavāsasī skhalatpadayugāpātapatitā punarutthitā

etatpraṇayayogena rahasye kāmakalpanā ityādibhāvabharitaghṛṇālajjāvivarjitā dūtīmukhena lekhairvā jijñāsāsphuritādharā kimarthaṃ kimanuṣṭhātā kiṃ vā te'bhimataṃ vada tadā tadbhāvacaturo bhāvabodhahavirbhuje tatra sthitvā puraḥkṣobhaṃ kuryāt kāma ivāparaḥ tenaiva kulakāṣṭhena yantraṃ kṛtvā tadantare patre mahiṣamardinyā navavarṇaṃ likhettataḥ likhitvā pūjayedrātrau bhadrakālīṃ samāhitaḥ digvāsā galitāśeṣacikuraḥ kulakaulikaḥ sphuracchavakaraśreṇīkṛtakāñcīṃ digambarīm śrutimūlasamākīrṇasṛkkanīṃ caṇḍanādinīm madirāmoditāsphālakampitākhilamedinīm [sphāra] varābhayayutāṃ ghoravadanāṃ lolajihvikām śivābhirghorarāvābhiḥ [sphāra] sevitāṃ pralayoditām [praṇavoditām] gṛhītanarakaṅkālairjayaśabdaparāyaṇaiḥ evaṃ tāṃ kālikāṃ dhyātvā pūjayet kulasiddhaye [nāyakaḥ] yat kiñcit kulasiddhistu jāyate na manāgapi ataḥ sā dakṣiṇā nāmnī triṣu lokeṣu gīyate kālīmantreṇa sādhyādigrathitena ca bhairava varālṃakāraracito viśet parapuraṃ tataḥ siddhārthaṃ vāmahaste tu gṛhītvā mantramuccaran bhittvā tatra viśedrātrau niḥśaṅkaḥ kṣobhavarjitaḥ aśvāgāre rathāgāre kālikāgārasaṃnidhau dhyātvā svapnavatīṃ vidyāṃ [devīṃ] praviśet kāmamaṇḍapam

ke yūyamī vaktavye vayaṃ ca vīrapūruṣāḥ tatra pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pitarau paramāspadam devīkūṭe tathoḍḍīne kāmarūpe tatastaṭe eṣu vinyasya cakrāṇi pūjayitvā praṇamya ca japtvā pīṭhaṃ samādāya bhāṇḍāgāraṃ tato viśet rakṣāpīṭhaṃ puraskṛtya praṇamet pīṭhasaṃmukham kulapūjāṃ kariṣyāmi upacāraṃ prayaccha me kulapuṣpaṃ [phalaṃ puṣpaṃ] tathā gandhaṃ naivedyaṃ punarāharet samādāya tathā pūjāṃ kṛtvā paktvā nijecchayā ghṛtaṃ madhu tathā cānyad yadvā yatraiva labhyate nijeṣṭadevatāṃ dhyātvā nivedya śāstramārgataḥ nivedayet svayaṃ cārdhaṃ bhakṣayitvā puraḥsthitaḥ yadi no vidyate yoṣā tatastoye visarjayet pituḥ samīpe saṃsthāpya tattvacintāparo bhavet kāmarūpaṃ praviśyāśu kāmākhyāyonimaṇḍapam sādhyasādhakanāmnā ca darbhitaṃ vipulīkṛtam kāmena kāmayet kāmaṃ kāmaṃ kāmena [kāmī] yojayet mātṛpīṭhe pitṛmukhaṃ sthāpayitvā vidhānataḥ kākiṇīṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadyogyaṃ harate haṭhāt paurāṅganānāṃ dravyaṃ vā parirakṣitureva vā teṣāṃ prahāraścāturyaṃ vyabhicārakulakṣatiḥ baddhaścaivābhibhūyate anyacaureṇa vā teṣāṃ kulīnena ca śaṃkara ! bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācā vā rākṣasā vā sarīsṛpāḥ vidyādharī bhairavaśca vaṭuko gaṇapastathā

apatyahāniṃ vikṣobhaṃ vyādhimuñcāṭanaṃ tathā etat purapaterevaṃ tat kāraṇādyadi śaṃkara ! tasmāt sarvaprayatnena prabodhaṃ kārayed guruḥ vajraṃ śaktiṃ tathā daṇḍaṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṅkuśam piṣṭakaṃ kadalaṃ deva ! modakaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā viṣṇave paramānnaṃ ca gaṇeśāya ca pīṭhakam kṣetreśāya kṛṣṇacchāgaṃ datvā vīramanuṃ tataḥ yathā yajñe'bhiṣikte'śve yathā śakrādibhiḥ suraiḥ śayanāgāra aiśāne kulaśaṅkhaṃ nidhāpayet kṛtvā tatra yantrarājaṃ pūjayenniśi sādhakaḥ na karoti kathaṃ deva ! sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavet rātrau sthitvā kulācārakathāṃ [kulācāre] tribhuvaneśvarīm prātaḥ snātvā guruṃ natvā pitṝn devān ṛṣīṃstathā tato [tataḥ purapateḥ] yuvatisevāyā yatkiṃcidvyapadeśataḥ dravyādinā tatra vāpi yathā bhavati bhairava ! asyopari kṛpā tasyāḥ kīdṛśī vyapadeśataḥ kenāpi vyapadeśena kulacūḍāmaṇiṃ svataḥ likhitvā nijayantraṃ vā kulayantramathāpi vā madhye tat kulanāmnā ca darbhitaṃ nijanāmabhiḥ pūjayet sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ kulāmnāyaparāyaṇaḥ gacchan svadan naman vāpi skhalan viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ smartavyo'haṃ kulābhijñairaraṇye vā jalāśaye tato rātrau śūnyagehe udyāne vā surālaye tataḥ pūrvoktarūpeṇa kulakṣobhaṃ samācaret [samārabhet] pīṭhānāṃ paramaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ mahāphalam

vihāya sarvapīṭhāni tatra [tasyā dehe] putra vasāmyaham teṣāṃ phalaṃ mahādeva ! bahu kiṃ kathyate'dhunā yat pīṭhaṃ brahmaṇo vaktraṃ guptaṃ sarvasukhāvaham sarve'pyāvirbhavantyatra tena guptaṃ mahākulaiḥ [sadā kulam] vyaktād guhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ durāpaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ guptaṃ sarvatra deveśa ! labhyate kulasundaraiḥ putro'smi yadi deveśi ! sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇi ! yadārādhanamātreṇa devānākarṣayennaraḥ [yeddhruvam] kālīmantra udāhṛtaḥ japtvā karṣayati svairaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamādikam suptā nidrāmitā mattā bhrāmitāvanatā [vidrāvaṇaratā parā] tathā niśācāraṃ divācāraṃ saṃdhyācāraṃ ca pallavam jñātvā prabodhayeddhīro gururatraikakāraṇam yadvā tadvā yena kena sarvadā sarvato'pi ca yathāyaskāntamātreṇa gūḍhaviddhaśiloccayaḥ sūryakāntaḥ spuṭaruciryathā ca raviraśmibhiḥ mahādurgāprasādena yathā siddhiśvaro bhavet yathākarṣaṇamātreṇa śiva eva prajāyate tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dīkṣayennijakaulikīm kālikā dakṣiṇā devī caturvargaphalapradā ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena kuryādaṅgādikalpanām hṛdaye hastayoḥ pādayugale vinyasettataḥ pañcadhā dhyānamekatra pūrvoktaṃ ca samācaret tatrāvāhya yajeddevīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kulabhūṣaṇām kālīṃ kapālinīṃ kullāṃ prathame ca trikoṇake

ugramukhīmugraprabhāṃ pradīptāṃ ca tathaiva ca brahmāṇyādyāstathā bāhye yajet pūrvadale kramāt lakṣaṃ rātrau tathā lakṣaṃ mahāśaucaparāyaṇaḥ rātrau japaikamātreṇa siddhidā dakṣiṇā bhavet araṇyāmathavā rātrau mahākālī mahodayā ākarṣayeddevakanyāṃ pātāle nāgakanyakām pūjā dhyānaṃ prayogaṃ ca japaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ japādikaṃ vāri sarvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ cātra kīrtitam īśāne śaṅkhamāsādya tatra yantraṃ vilikhya ca aṣṭottaraśataṃ martyo mantrayitvā susaṃyataḥ madirāghūrṇanayanaḥ parayoṣitsamāgame yannāmnā darbhitaṃ yantraṃ pūjayedvīravallabhaḥ madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā vatsa ! yat kiṃcit kulasādhanam tadanujñāṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā śeṣaṃ cātmani yojayet janmāntarasahasrasya sukṛtaṃ tasya naśyati brāhmaṇastāmrapātreṣu madhu madyaṃ prakalpayet yogibhiḥ pīyate madyaṃ tanmadyaṃ yogipuṃgavaiḥ na madyaṃ pānayogyaṃ syādyanmadyaṃ guḍapiṣṭakam ānīya devīṃ tad gātre vyāpakaṃ vinyasettataḥ vilikhya yantraṃ pūrvoktaṃ pūjayet kulavartmanā mahābhāgāṃ tato mūladevīmāvaraṇaiḥ saha tatpīṭhe yoganidrākhyāṃ pūjayitvā tato yajet kāmarūpaṃ tato gatvā tataḥ kātyāyanīṃ yajet tato jālaṃdhare gatvā pūrṇeśīṃ prathamaṃ yajet tataḥ pūrṇagirau gatvā yajeccaṇḍīṃ tato japet

tataḥ prānte mahādevīṃ yajeddikkaravāsinīm saptapīṭhe saptalakṣaṃ japtvā rātrau samāhitaḥ evaṃ kṛte vismṛtā cet svanāmni gotrajanmani tataḥ praṇamya deveśīṃ vṛṇuyādvaramātmanaḥ akṣobhitakulācāraparicaryāparāyaṇaḥ tataḥ prasannā bhavati svairaṃ kulavarapriyā rājavṛkṣaṃ samālokya tanmūle sveṣṭadevatām lakṣapīṭhaphalaṃ deva ! labhate sādhakottamaḥ añjanaṃ tilakaṃ guptiṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīm sādhayet sādhako'bhīṣṭaṃ mūlavidyāṃ maheśvara ! tanme [tattvaṃ] kathaya deveśi ! yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati bhaumavāre madhyarātrau śavāsanayugāṅkite tatsahasraṃ hunedvatsa ! tatraiva pitṛkānane gatvā durgāṣṭamīrātrau śmaśāne nikṣipettataḥ śavāsanagato vīro japedaṣṭasahasrakam sphe'm [sphreṃ sphreṃ] spheṃ daṇḍa mahābhāga yoginīhṛdayapriya ! evamāmantrya vetālaṃ yatra yatra prayujyate gaccha gaccha mahābhāge ! pāduke ! varavarṇini aṣṭalohaṃ [khaḍgabāhuṃ] samāsādya pañcāśadaṅgulākṛtim tat sahasraṃ tato japtvā mahāśavakalevare kulāṣṭamyāmardharātre citāmadhye samāhitaḥ madhuratrayasaṃyuktaṃ bilvapatreṇa saṃyutam balyante paramā māyā devī mahiṣamardinī gṛhṇa vatseti śabde vai khaḍgamuttolya dhārayet kāṁ īṁ ūṁ kuru kalyāṇi vipakṣacchedavistaram

chittvā chittvā punaśchittvā gacchatyākṛṣyate punaḥ kuje catuṣpathe rātrau nikhanenmantritaṃ tataḥ tāvad bhuktvā haviṣyānnaṃ pratirātraṃ japedabhīḥ utpannaṃ patramālokya chittvā niśchidramānayet tamānīya suhṛtsaṅgaḥ kṣālayenmantramuccaran tadānīya yajettatra kālikāṃ ghoraniḥsvanām siddhājjano bhavenmantrī nātra kāryā vicāraṇā kṛtvā saṃpūjya [tilakamādāya] vidhivat sarvaṃ jayati sādhakaḥ kulasthāne samānīya dattvā devyai prayatnataḥ bhūmau phūtkāramātreṇa vivaraṃ tatra jāyate tatraiva gamanaṃ tasya bhūtalāntaḥprasarpiṇaḥ kāyasaṃkocamāsādya gacchatyavikalo naraḥ siddhayaḥ kulanātheśa ! jāyante na kathaṃcana kulācārasya saṃsiddhyai bhuktimuktiprasiddhaye gopyā sarvaprayatnena śṛṇu tāṃ kathayāmi te sṛṣṭisaṃhārakau varṇau vidyā mahiṣamardinī sarvadevasarvasiddhibījabhūtā sanātanī tadāṣṭavarṇaṃ vaktavyaṃ na bījaṃ nāpi sādhanam etat pūrvasthitā devī gurusiddhivināśinī gurūṇāṃ kulanāthānāṃ mahāśāpapradāyinī trailokyabījabhūtānte sā parā mardinīkulam dattā ca paramā vidyā ṅeyutā hṛdayānvitā tasmāt sarvaprayatnena goptavyeyaṃ navākṣarī nārado'sya ṛṣiḥ proktaśchando gāyatramīritam dhyāyet kālīṃ mahādaityayuddharāgamadonmukhīm

vāme khaḍgaṃ tathā carma dhanustarjanameva ca pītāmbaradharāṃ devīṃ pīnonnatakucadvayām oṃ mahiṣa(daitya)śatro hūṃ phaṭ śirasyudīritam oṃ mahiṣaṃ heṣaya heṣaya hūṃ (phaṭ) śikhāmantraḥ samīritaḥ mahiṣamardinī hūṃ phaṭ astrāṇi śṛṇu bhairava āyudhāni palāśāgre yādibhiḥ kramaśo yajet siddhamantrī tadastrāṇi prayogaṃ ca samācaret eṣā vidyā mahāvidyā na deyā yasya kasyacit dīkṣitā kulajātistu siddhidā saiva nānyathā prāptānantarasārṇave mama manohaṃsaściraṃ nandatu sevante karivairiṇaṃ kimaribhirbhītirbhavetsevinaḥ cchrīmatpādapayojacumbanaparaṃ māmadya saṃbhāvaya śrīmatpādapayojacintanavidhau cittaṃ sadaivāstu naḥ maccitte'kṣatasaṃpadi prasaratu kṣemaṃkari ! kṣamyatām nmādhvīpūrṇabhavatpadaikakamalāmodena nāsvāditaḥ śrīmadbhaktirasātidurdinaparīvāhaḥ sadā sarpatu pāṭhaḥ] dṛpyaddaivatavairdāraṇapaṭurjīyājjayāhlādinī truṭyatkhaṇḍavikhaṇḍitākhilaśakuntakṣutpipāsojjvale smaret iti tantrasāre] dvīrāsphālalasatkarālavadanāṃ ghorāṭṭahāsodbhaṭām stambhoccāṭanamāraṇādikṛtināṃ teṣāṃ svayaṃ jāyate steṣāṃ hastagatā bhavanti jagatāṃ mātarnamaste jaya paśya mūrtiṃ na ca dhyānayogyāṃ mama sukhāvaham tripurā bhairavīmūrtirādyā sā parikīrtitā

yoginīpūjanaṃ tatra pradhānaṃ kulapūjanam tathā kulatithau durgā pūjitā varadāyinī māṃsapradhānaṃ naivedyaṃ saṃdhyākāle vidhīyate paśurūpā samāyāti parivāragaṇaiḥ saha tadaiva maṅgalaṃ tasya nānyathā kulabhūṣaṇa ! nityaśrāddhaṃ tathā saṃdhyāvandanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam paśurūpāṃ śivāṃ devīṃ yo nārcayati nirjane japapūjāvidhānāni yatkiṃcitsukṛtāni ca ekayā bhujyate yatra śivayā deva bhairava ! paśuśaktirnaraśaktiḥ pakṣiśaktistathaiva [pakṣiśaktiśca bhairava] ca tena sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mahat śubhāśubhāni karmāṇi vicintya balimāharet śubhāśubhaphalaṃ vyaktaṃ brūhi gṛhṇa baliṃ tava yadā na gṛhyate vatsa ! tadā naiva śubhaṃ bhavet evaṃ matvā mahādeva ! śāntisvastyayanaṃ caret na kasmaicitpravaktavyaṃ yadīcchecchāśvataṃ sukham na pituḥ saṃnidhāne vā na mātuḥ saṃnidhau tathā pātālamaṇḍape vāpi maṇḍape vā suyantrite kulapuṣpaṃ kuladravyaṃ kulapūjāṃ kule japam kulacakraṃ kuladhyānaṃ sarvathā na prakāśayet prakāśānmantranāśaḥ syātprakāśādeva hiṃsanam pūjākāle tu deveśa ! yadi ko'pyatra gacchati prakāśādyadi guptiḥ syāttatprakāśānna dūṣaṇam kadācidaṅgahānistu na ca vyaktiḥ kadācana etattantraṃ gṛhe yasya kulākṣarasamanvitam

teṣāṃ gṛheṣu pāpāni duṣkṛtāni bhayādikam likhitvā kulahastena kuladravyeṇa bhairava sarvathā tasya gehaṃ [dehaṃ] vai na saṃtyakṣyāmi bhairava ! etattantrasamāyogāttyājyo na hi kathaṃcana etadgranthasamāyogāt kapālīkaraṇaṃ yadi saṃpūjya kuladevaṃ ca gṛhṇīyāccaiva nānyathā rājyahānirvaraṃ vāpi sutahānistu vā punaḥ manmāyāmohitaṃ cāpi anyadevarato'pi ca yathā yoṣiccharīreṇa vicarāmi punaḥ punaḥ mahācīnakramaṃ vāpi mahānīlaṃ sadāśivam kulācāraṃ vinā vatsa naiva siddhipravartakam yoginīnāṃ sadā pūjā manasāpi na hīyate abhibhūtisamākīrṇaṃ vyādhiyuktaṃ ca bhairava ! saptāhaṃ kramayogena mukto bhavati durgrahāt na kasmaicitprayoktavyaṃ pravaktavyaṃ kathaṃcana tvameva vaktā śāstrāṇāṃ na paro'pi maheśvara ! kāraṇāvasthayāpannā yadyahaṃ kularūpiṇī kāryabhāvasamāpannā yadāhaṃ viśvarūpiṇī ahaṃ viśāmi tvaddehe śaktyā yukto bhava prabhuḥ ataḥ kārye samutpanne putratvaṃ tvayi vartate atastvameva janako nāstyanyo'pi kathaṃcana kadācitputratāpannaḥ kadācicchiṣya eva hi śivaśaktisamāyogāt kulādermuktikalpanā tasmāttvameva sarvatra sarvatrāhaṃ maheśvara ! gurustvaṃ yadi śiṣyo'haṃ tadā māstu vivecanā
